mapping.summary: Word-based document templates for printing, previewing and emailing BC documents, optionally built by AI.
claims: Uses your own .docx layout with {{Token}} placeholders filled from BC fields
Equerra can build a template package from your existing document using an AI agent, optionally
Templates bind to report selections so Print, Preview, Send and Post and Send use them, incl. document sending profiles
Live preview as quick view or exact PDF before certifying
Output can also be downloaded as HTML, CSV, XML or JSON
Templates export and import between companies and environments
Prints lot and serial numbers under document lines
Prints amounts in words, English only
Prints GST, Sales Tax or VAT wording based on country
Covers 15 standard documents incl. invoices, quotes, statements, POs, remittance advice and pick lists
Draft templates cannot print or email; certifying rejects unmapped placeholders
Blocks multi-vendor remittance runs on email or disk
Separate user and admin permission sets
BC online version 28.1 or later; document wording can be any language
